{{Quote|Did you find anything on Hoth?''"<br />"''Nothing. They must have already taken the Force energy from there.''"<br />"''Just as others have reported. Bespin, Endor, Coruscant, everywhere.|Skywalker and Korr ponder on the activities of the Disciples of Ragnos|<ref name="Jedi Academy" />}}
A '''mission''' to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was carried out by a member of the [[Jedi Praxeum]] during the [[Disciples of Ragnos crisis]] in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]].<ref name="Jedi Academy" />

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] sent several Jedi to places where he felt a strong connection to the Force, after [[Alora (Dark Jedi)|Alora]] sliced into his records. The objective of the mission was to investigate cult or [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] presence on the planet. The [[mission to Bespin]] was inconclusive, and Skywalker and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Apprentice [[Jaden Korr]] suspected the cult had already drained the [[Force energy]] from the sites mentioned in Luke's personal records.<ref name="Jedi Academy" />

Praxeum students would later return to Coruscant, as [[Jaden Korr]] was [[Second mission to Coruscant (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|sent]] to deal with [[Lannik Racto]].<ref name="Jedi Academy" />
